question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Barcoded lineage tracing across a state transition
ideas.description: Use clonal DNA barcodes to split sister cells, measuring AP-1 motif accessibility or FOS/JUN levels in one half and challenging the other half with a stimulus such as a drug or differentiation cue. Ask whether the pre-measured AP-1 state predicts the clone's eventual fate, the core test of a heritable, predictive memory.

ideas.title: Degron-based timed removal separating establishment from maintenance
ideas.description: Tag c-JUN/c-FOS with an auxin or dTAG degron (or express dominant-negative A-FOS) and deplete AP-1 either during a priming stimulus or only after it ends. Memory requires that post-stimulus depletion erases the primed response even though the initiating signal is already gone.

ideas.title: Direct measurement of persistence and heritability timescales
ideas.description: Track an endogenous AP-1 reporter such as a knock-in FOS-HaloTag or AP-1 motif-driven fluorophore by live imaging across many divisions. Extract state autocorrelation times, mother-daughter correlations, and switching rates to distinguish true multigenerational memory from slow protein turnover.

ideas.title: Decoupling AP-1 binding from chromatin accessibility
ideas.description: Perform paired ATAC-seq and CUT&RUN for JUN/FOS before, during, and long after stimulation to test whether stimulus-opened enhancers remain accessible after AP-1 unbinds. This asks whether AP-1 acts as a pioneer factor that writes a latent chromatin memory read out upon restimulation.

ideas.title: Synthetic write/erase perturbation of specific AP-1 enhancers
ideas.description: Use dCas9-VPR or targeted recruitment of JUN to a defined set of AP-1-bound enhancers, plus CRISPRi or deletion to remove them. Test whether transiently imposing the AP-1 state suffices to install a long-lived primed phenotype and whether erasing those elements abolishes memory of prior exposure.
